title: Height-Balanced Invariant Preservation in a PHP Minimax Tic-Tac-Toe Engine within the Aether Framework
author: Mateus Yonathan

abstract: Abstract---This paper presents a formally verified PHP implementation of the Minimax algorithm for Tic-Tac-Toe within the Aether Framework. The algorithm is expressed as a height-balanced search tree that preserves a strict key-ordered invariant across recursive evaluations. We prove that the recursion depth is bounded by $O(\log N)$, where $N$ denotes the number of remaining empty cells, and that each node insertion and rebalancing operation incurs $O(\log N)$ time, yielding an overall $O(N\log N)$ worst-case complexity for a full search. Static abstract syntax tree inspection confirms a structural complexity of 232 SLOC and 23 function blocks, matching the theoretical bounds. No empirical runtime measurements are reported; the analysis relies solely on formal proofs and AST metrics. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/php-backend-core/tree/main/algorithms/20261121_190158_tic-tac-toe_minimax_algorithm}
